verdict.rationale: Sierra is an AI agent platform, so plugging in MCP servers as tool sources is a fair question to ask of it. The only MCP evidence is an engineering blog about an internal gateway that connects AI agents to 'the tools and systems that power our company.' That describes Sierra's own internal infrastructure, not a documented customer-facing ability to register external MCP servers for a Sierra agent to use, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
